# THOUGHT Glyph Library — Second Set

This directory is the explicit **2nd Set** of the THOUGHT Glyph Library.

- Stable set ID: `inshell.thought.glyph-library.set-02`
- Set version: `1`
- Qualification status: `exploratory-complete`
- Members: exactly **36** native-SVG path-glyph fonts
- Construction groups: **12 segment masks + 12 stroke graphs + 12 routed paths**
- Repertoire: 76 characters per font, including metrics-only SPACE

The set is frozen as an **exploratory-complete study field**, not as 36 final production choices. Independent review found 21 legibility passes, 20 identity passes, 9 fonts passing both gates, and 27 combined holds. All 36 pass the expanded native-SVG protocol; all 36 remain on compact/on-chain storage hold.

These are JSON-native SVG path systems, not OpenType, WOFF, or CSS `@font-face` files.

Open [gallery.html](gallery.html) to compare all 36 and filter the 9 dual-pass candidates. Read [REVIEW.md](REVIEW.md), [storage-model.json](storage-model.json), and [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md) before downstream use. Run:

```sh
npm run verify
```

before consuming or updating the bundle.
